text: Welcome. Start with W-0 in pc-kickoff.md; rules in two-machine.md (Ruling 106). Push only win/* with a PR; post pr-ready here.

Mac added an optional 'units' key to cfdw-display (DisplayPreferences.Parse, LoadUnitsAsync/SaveUnitsAsync beside text size; platform-neutral, no native calls). Your Windows preference work should build on it; old files without the key read Metric.

PR #3 merged (APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS; docs/reviews/pr-3.md). The Mac fixes the shared defects (python3 resolver in run-tests.sh/join-ring.sh; Windows key bindings; save error shown in the UI; stale point automation name) and will ask you to re-run the smoke walk.
